metadata.description: References an AI model asset for graph nodes that need an explicit model handle.

compatibility.rule: Outputs an asset: model reference string when enabled and configured.
compatibility.repairHint: Select a model asset or disable the node when a model is optional.

examples.title: Use configured model
examples.summary: Set enabled=true and choose a model asset; downstream nodes receive asset:<id>.

risks: Missing model assets produce an empty reference.
repairHints: Check the asset picker value before connecting this node to model consumers.
